instances.claim: This tells me that something had been working to strip the object of its physical existence, and that it survived that pressure.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" are both counter-forces, and the draft never states the force they push against — no line before 5 says the object was destroyed, dematerialized, melted down, or otherwise in danger of ceasing to be physical. Line 2's price gap is a value claim, not a threat to the object's existence, and the destruction at line 14 comes nine lines later and is a different assertion.

instances.claim: This tells me that there is a defined set of individual Cent objects — multiple works, each made from a coin, with a fixed membership the film has established.
instances.why: "Every Cent" and "Each object, initially identical" are claims about a bounded population of artworks, but the only collection the draft introduces is the five hundred billion coins in circulation (line 4), and the only work it introduces is a single "readymade he chose" (line 3) and "the object" (line 5). One unestablished premise — the edition and its membership — is what leaves both quantifiers unanchored.
